title: Hedging and Diplomacy in Academic Discussion / Kɔfale ye Masiralinw kɔnɔkifɛnw tɛmɛ jɛnɲɔgɔnya

title: Strategic Hedging & Diplomatic Language / Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya

rule: Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 1) Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: perhaps, possibly, arguably, presumably, allegedly (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). 2) Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: seem, appear, tend to, suggest (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). 3) Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: might, may, could (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). 4) Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 'It could be argued that...', 'One might say that...' (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). 5) Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 'a bit', 'slightly', 'somewhat' (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: højɔkulɔfɛ, i sira kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la, nka, i bena sɛbɛn fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la. Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 'Es posible que esté equivocado' → 'It is possible that I am wrong' (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 'I'd suggest we consider...' (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). Fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la: 'I see your point, but have we considered...?' (fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la donw kanbɛlɛnsiya ka fɔlɔw kanbɛlɛnsiya la). title: Nuanced Literary Analysis: Register, Tone, and Implied Meaning / Aŋaraŋa kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ tɔɔwɔ kelen: kɔfale, tɔn, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw
bridge: Espaɲe kan, subjuntiiboo lo ka fɔlɔ fana kɔrɔmani bɛɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diimansa kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ tɔɔwɔ kelen. Aŋkaɲɛman, C1 tɔɔwɔlo kɛra ka jati fɔlɔ modal verbs (might, could, would) lo, passive voice ka jamana kɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman. Espaɲe kan batoo bɛɛ tɔɔwɔlo kɛlɛtɔɔ bɛɛ bɛɛ ka tɔɔwɔ lo ka fɔlɔ 'es posible que...' ka 'it is possible that...' ka fɔlɔ fana, nka, aŋkaɲɛman tɛ bɛɛ ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman adverbs (arguably, ostensibly) wala modal verbs lo, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman present historic tense dɔn past perfect tense lo ka diiman kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋɔ tɔɔwɔ kelen.
rule:
Aŋkaɲɛman kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ tɔɔwɔ kelen kɛ ka diiman C1 tɔɔwɔlo kɛra ka jati:
1. **Kɔfale akademisi kɔfale**: Verbs *suggest, imply, illustrate, portray* lo ka jamana kɛ, *show* wala *tell* tɔɔ, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman discourse markers (however, moreover, consequently).
2. **Modal verbs ka jamana kɛ ka diiman tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ**: *Must* ka jamana kɛ ka diiman dedukisi lɔɔw, *might/may* ka jamana kɛ ka diiman tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman *could* ka jamana kɛ ka diiman tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ. Espaɲe kan, tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ subjuntiibo lo ka jamana kɛ ka diiman: 'Quizás el autor intentara...' ka tɔɔwɔlo kɛ 'The author might be trying...' wala 'Perhaps the author is trying...'.
3. **Passive voice ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman 'it' lo**: Ka kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ (it is argued, it could be said). Espaɲe kan, 'se' impersonal lo ka jamana kɛ ka diiman, nka, aŋkaɲɛman passive voice lo ka jamana kɛ ka diiman.
4. **Present historic tense**: Ka diiman kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋɔ tɔɔwɔ kelen (In Chapter 3, the protagonist meets...), ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman Espaɲe kan present tense lo ka jamana kɛ ka diiman, nka preterite tense lo ka jamana kɛ ka diiman kɛ fɛɛnʋʋ kanu kɛ fɛɛnʋɔ tɔɔwɔ kelen.
5. **Tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman tɔɔwɔ kɛlɛyaŋ tɛ bɛɛ minw ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman**: *in order to, so as to, with the aim of* tɔɔ *para*, ɲɛfɔ an ka tɔɔw bɛɛw kɛ ka diiman *due to, owing to* tɔɔ 'debido a'.

title: The Art of Nuance: Hedging and Speculating / L’art du nuance: Atténuer et spéculer
bridge: A espanyol ca, jamana b’an kaara beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara (màlà «Quizás venga»). A anglese ca, sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu, ni jògò-jògòw ni fòlòw fòlòw kanu tugu amincè, fòlò ni «may well», «might as well» ni «I dare say». Sòrònin k’a faara b’an tugu minw ka taa anglese ca, a ka taa espanyol ca, sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu minw ka taa anglese ca, a ka taa espanyol ca, fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè, fòlò ni «maybe» ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè. A ka taa anglese ca, a ka taa espanyol ca, fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè, fòlò ni «maybe» ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè.
rule: A anglese C1 ca, kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè, fòlò ni: 1) Fòlòw fòlòw kanu tugu amincè (may, might, could, should, ought to) ni sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè. 2) Fòlòw fòlòw kanu tugu amincè (might have, could have) kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè. 3) Jògò-jògòw ni fòlòw fòlòw kanu tugu amincè: arguably, presumably, allegedly, in all likelihood, by any stretch of the imagination. 4) Fòlòw fòlòw kanu tugu amincè (hedges) fòlò ni «I would venture to say», «It stands to reason that», «One might argue that». 5) Inversiòw ni «should/were» kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè. 6) «Seem/appear» ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè, ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè. Sòrònin k’a faara b’an tugu minw ka taa anglese ca, a ka taa espanyol ca, sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni kondisiyoneeli kanu fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè, fòlò ni «maybe» ka tugu ka kàra beeri don cogoɲ kanu fòlòwò ni fòlòwò sababu sòrònin k’a faara ka tugu amincè.

title: Nuanced Political Commentary / Faranma yaasi jɛmaw fɔlɔw kanbɔlɔ
bridge: Sipanɛɣin fɛ, an ka tɛmɛ kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani kɛ an ka sɔrɔ a fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ. A fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ, an ka tɛmɛ kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani kɛ an ka sɔrɔ a fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ. A fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ, an ka tɛmɛ kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani kɛ an ka sɔrɔ a fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ. A fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ, an ka tɛmɛ kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani kɛ an ka sɔrɔ a fɛ ka sɔrɔ o kɔ.
rule: Faranma yaasi jɛmaw fɔlɔw kanbɔlɔ fɛ, an ka tɛmɛ: 1) Kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'should' (tɛmɛntɔ, 'The policy might backfire'). 2) Kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani 'it' + kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani: 'it is argued', 'it has been suggested', 'it is widely believed'. 3) Kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani: 'profound', 'utterly', 'deeply', 'marginally'. 4) Kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani: 'while', 'whereas', 'even though'. 5) Kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani 'tend to' fɔlɔw kanbɔlɔ filimuw ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɔrɔmani. Taliki 'I think' ka tɛmɛw; tɛmɛ 'I would argue', 'It seems to me'. Faranma yaasi jɛmaw fɔlɔw kanbɔlɔ fɛ, an ka tɛmɛ 'should' n'a 'indicative mood' tɛmɛw.

title: Advanced debate techniques / Faranw bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana
bridge: Sipaniladenw, bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana kanu bɛɛ, koɲumanw ye haye kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra. Anw kaɲaŋ, kooɲumanw ye haye kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra ka haye kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'while it may be true that...', 'even granting that...', 'that said...'. Kɔfɛ, angilikanw maboya bɛɛw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra ka haye kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'I take your point, but...' bɛɛ maboya ka 'entiendo lo que dices, pero...' ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra. Kɛlɛba: 'por supuesto' ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra 'of course' ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra, 'admittedly' wala 'granted' bɛɛ maboya.
rule: Bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 1) Kooɲumanw + haye kooɲumanw: 'While it is true that [X], it is also the case that [Y]' wala 'Even granting that [X], we must still consider [Y]'. Sipathiladenw, 'aunque' wala 'si bien' bɛɛ maboya, anw kaɲaŋ, 'while' ka bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra. 2) Bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'That argument does not hold up because...', 'This is a fallacy of false equivalence', 'I dispute the premise that...'. 3) Kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'I see your point, but...', 'Respectfully, I disagree', 'That may be true, but...'. 'Yes, but' bɛɛ maboya; 'however', 'nevertheless', 'nonetheless' bɛɛ maboya, anw kaɲaŋ, koma bɛɛ maboya. 4) Bɛɛw kanu kelen ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'Consider the counterexample of...', 'This is contradicted by the fact that...'. 5) Kooɲumanw ka jamana bɛ sanji kɛra: 'That might be the case, but...', 'You could argue that, yet...'. Sipathiladenw, 'pero' ye 'sin embargo' bɛɛ maboya; angilikanw, 'however' wala 'though' bɛɛ maboya.

title: Navigating Academic Discourse / Disikuru akadɛmikifɛn kanbɛlenw
bridge: A taali gi, disikuru akadɛmiki bɛ fɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. Kɔfɛ tiɲɛ n ye ko subjonkti ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. A fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la, nka, a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la.
rule: C1 kanbɛlenw la, i kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la: (1) Verbow ka taali gi, disikuru akadɛmiki bɛ fɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la (e.g., 'suggest', 'argue', 'maintain', 'contend') ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la (e.g., 'The study suggests that the effect be considered'). (2) Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la (e.g., 'draw a conclusion', 'pose a question', 'address an issue', 'make a case'). (3) Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la (e.g., 'furthermore', 'however', 'conversely', 'in light of') ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. (4) Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la (e.g., 'has been argued', 'might be attributed to') ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. (5) Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la '-tion', '-ment', '-ness' (e.g., 'implementation', 'assessment') ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la. Kɔfɛ tiɲɛ n ye ko 'suggest' la 'recommend' ka kanbɛlenw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la; a fɛn bɛ ka kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la ('suggests that the data are...'). Kɛlɛyaŋw kɛ ka sɛbɛnwitɔgɔw la 'in order to' (basta 'to') la 'due to the fact that' (usa 'because').

title: Idiomatic Expressions & Colloquialisms / Modismu dɔnkɛnw kanbɛnw
bridge: A tɛ sɔrɔ Espaniyakɛ fɛ, i jaara ka modismukɔw bɛɛ kanbɛnw bɛɛ minw be jati fɛ i ka jɛnɲɔgɔnya bɛ Anglɛkan (kɔfɛ, 'estar en las nubes' ka 'to be in the clouds'), nka, modismukɔ fo baara minw i sira k'a laban tɛ. Espaniyakɛw jaara ka tɔgɔyaji kɛ 'tener' ka baara minw be jati fɛ 'tener hambre' ka 'I have hunger' ka baara minw b'a yɛrɛ fɛ 'I'm hungry'. A ka kanbɛnw fana, Anglɛkan jaara ka tɔgɔyaji kɛ phrasal verbs dɔnkɛn kanbɛnw minw tɛ ɲinɛ Espaniyakɛ fɛ, mɛn ka kɛlɛ i kɛ sira kɛnɛ ka baara minw be jati fɛ, tɛmɛn i kɛ sira kɛnɛ ka baara minw b'a yɛrɛ fɛ. title: Hedging and Softening Strategies for Near-Native Fluency / K'a cogo ɲɛsin ka ban ye tiɲɛ ye jɔ caaman fanga la
bridge: Tɔgɔ, muusu-muusu done bɛ fɔlɔ fana tɛ bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye. Denw bɛɛ, bɛ fɔlɔ fana tɛ bɛɛ ka kanu, adivɛrbi done bɛɛ ka sira kanu (might, could), ka kɛlɛ ye fɔlɔw la (perhaps, probably), ka kɛlɛ ye fɔlɔw la (I was wondering, It seems like). Kɔrɔnin-kɔrɔnin bɛɛ, bɛ fɔlɔ fana tɛ bɛɛ ka kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye. K'a cogo ɲɛsin ka ban ye tiɲɛ ye jɔ caaman fanga la, o bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye.
rule: Denw bɛɛ, k'a cogo ɲɛsin ka ban ye tiɲɛ ye jɔ caaman fanga la: 1) Adivɛrbi done: 'might', 'could', 'would' (tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, 'That might be an issue' vs. 'That is an issue'). 2) Adivɛrbi la ka kɛlɛ ye: 'perhaps', 'maybe', 'probably', 'apparently', 'as far as I know'. 3) Fɔlɔw la ka kɛlɛ ye: 'I was wondering if...', 'I'm not sure, but...', 'It seems to me that...'. 4) Fɔlɔw la ka kɛlɛ ye: 'I'd say', 'I tend to think'. 5) Tag questions: '..., isn't it?' (C1 la, o bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn). Tɔgɔ, o bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye. Denw bɛɛ, o bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye. Kɔrɔnin-kɔrɔnin bɛɛ, o bɛɛ ka sira kanu, tɛmɛn tɛmɛn, laala kan kelen ye.
